purpose: Resolve the MATH clause of the registered capability win at a sample size chosen from the S66 replication's own interval half-width, on an instrument that is scored exactly once for the final claim and never for coefficient selection.

context.why_unresolved: At n=500 the MATH-500 paired intervals are +4.60 [+0.60,+8.60] (seed 0), +1.80 [-2.20,+5.60] (seed 1) and +3.40 [-0.60,+7.20] (seed 2). Every point estimate is positive; only seed 0's interval excludes zero. The clause that fails is interval width at n=500, not the sign of the effect.

instrument.name: Hendrycks MATH test split, all 5,000 problems
instrument.gold_rule: last balanced \boxed{} in the reference solution; the rule reproduces the MATH-500 answer field on all 500 overlapping problems with zero disagreements (results/datasets/math-test-fetch.json overlap_validation)
instrument.overlap_disclosure: MATH-500 is a 500-problem subset of these 5,000 problems. Scoring the full set therefore includes the 500 problems already scored during S65/S66. That is disclosed, not hidden: the resolution claim is made on the full-set paired interval, and the 500-item subset is reported separately rather than pooled with it.

protocol.prompt: the S54 user template ending in 'Put the final answer in \boxed{}'
protocol.primary_basis: flexible (the receipt's registered extraction); strict and exact are reported beside it and never substituted
protocol.statistic: paired problem-level bootstrap over the 5,000 distinct problems, 4,000 resamples, seed 53, percentile 2.5/97.5
protocol.comparison: candidate minus post-trained Qwen3.5-0.8B on the same problems under the same protocol; the baseline is scored on the full set too so the paired CI is computable

power_arithmetic.se_reduction_basis: sqrt(10); the estimator is a mean of per-problem paired differences and the bootstrap resamples problems, so SE scales as 1/sqrt(n) under exchangeability
power_arithmetic.conclusion: At 5,000 problems an effect of the observed +3.27 points is expected to resolve with a paired interval above zero, and the instrument resolves any true effect at or above about +1.8 points at 80% power. A true effect below that would still be unresolved, and that outcome will be reported as unresolved rather than as a win.
power_arithmetic.caveat: The expected interval is arithmetic from the S66 receipts, not a promise about the measured result. Problems are not guaranteed exchangeable across subjects; the bootstrap's resampling unit is the problem and is unchanged.

single_use_discipline.selection_instrument: results/stage2/s67-soup calibration on the 1,000-item train-split GSM8K-cal and MATH-cal splits, with MMLU-cal retention as a filter
single_use_discipline.no_post_hoc_enlargement: If the paired interval at n=5,000 includes zero, the MATH clause stays unresolved and the complete registered win stays unmet. The instrument will not be enlarged again after seeing this result.

mmlu_full.protocol: lm-evaluation-harness, 5-shot, identical for candidate and baseline
mmlu_full.split: all items partitioned into the 2,000 items the S60 coefficient selection read and the 12,042 never-used items (scripts/s66_retention_audit.py)
mmlu_full.bound: point drop <= 1.0 point and paired interval lower bound >= -1.0 point; an improvement is inside the bound

mmlu_pro_registered.protocol: lm-evaluation-harness, 5-shot, identical for candidate and baseline
mmlu_pro_registered.status_before_scoring: the 504-item retired sample is not admitted; this is the registered instrument and has not been scored for any model yet

verdict_definitions.replicated_gsm8k_win: GSM8K paired interval above zero on all three seeds (already established by S66).
verdict_definitions.math_effect_resolved_at_larger_n: the full-MATH paired interval is entirely above zero under this protocol.
verdict_definitions.complete_registered_win: GSM8K and MATH both resolved (full-MATH interval above zero) AND retention passes on full MMLU, the 12,042 unused MMLU items, and the 4,000-item MMLU-Pro instrument.
verdict_definitions.soup_beats_s65_seed0: the soup's paired interval against the S65 seed-0 checkpoint is above zero on at least one registered instrument; reported per instrument, not pooled.
verdict_definitions.soup_beats_post_trained: the soup's paired intervals against the post-trained 0.8B are above zero on GSM8K and on full MATH.
